en: In twenty twenty-six, I built a way back to the Moon.
zh: 2026 年，我做了这个游戏，想再回一次月球。

en: I wanted somewhere quiet enough to see home.
zh: 我想找个安静的地方，回头看看家。

en: Everyone I love lives on that fleck of blue.
zh: 我爱的人，都住在那一点蓝色里。

en: Look down. Just one pair of boots.
It took thousands of hands to get them here.
zh: 把这双靴子送到这里的，是千千万万双手。

en: Once, the whole world leaned toward a little screen.
zh: 曾经，全世界的人都凑近了一方小小的荧屏。

en: I came back for that feeling.
zh: 我想找回的，就是那种在一起的感觉。

en: I still believe we can go farther together.
zh: 我依然相信，我们可以一起走得更远。

en: From our blue Earth, we sail into eternity.
